textColorUsage.secondary: Normal secondary text on paper or near-white surface only; test against actual painted fill.
textColorUsage.secondaryOnTint: Small normal text on lavender, blush, tan, sage, and sand; ≥4.5:1 contrast.
textColorUsage.attentionText: Small text, including stateful pointer glyphs, on paper and all listed tints; ≥4.5:1 contrast.
textColorUsage.onAccent: Normal white foreground only against accent teal, not against light pastel accents.

contractChangeLog.reason: B independent support control scan identified 238 low-contrast source-painted control candidates; provide non-color-only 4-unit focus ring contract without claiming each is a WCAG violation.
Independent B static AA audit found secondary #566861 at 4.272:1 on tan; use contextual #445851, preserving original paper secondary.

rules: Visible outline around the currently focused actionable region, never color-only focus indication.
Maintain indicator contrast against the adjacent actual painted surface; focus shape must remain evident when card borders are low contrast.
Do not use a focus border to imply selection, successful apply, or current Android wallpaper state.
Native semantics, focus restoration and TalkBack require independent device verification.
